blocks.text: VALENCIA CITY, Bukidnon — A devastating predawn fire gutted bustling commercial and residential establishments in Purok 10, Barangay Poblacion here before dawn Wednesday. The inferno started at around 1 a.m., sending panicked residents scrambling into the streets with desperate shouts of “Fire! Fire!” Fire Officer 1 Christian Orong, arson investigator from the Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) Valencia, said the flames rapidly escalated to second alarm, with the fast-spreading fire completely gutting several establishments and two residences.
